install_torch_compiled_module: install torch.compile on a PyTorch module with dynamic argument dimensions and a custom backend
create_IntermediateTensors: create an IntermediateTensors object to pass hidden states and residuals between pipeline stages
infer_dynamic_arg_dims: infer dynamic argument dimensions from forward function type annotations automatically
mark_dynamic_on_value: mark tensor dimensions as dynamic for torch.dynamo compilation with IntermediateTensors support
normalize_dims: normalize negative dimension indices to positive indices for a tensor of given ndim
